title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG ASTOUNDS PASSEPARTOUT, HIS SERVANT
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg surprises Passepartout by announcing their immediate departure on a journey around the world in eighty days.
summary_detail: Fogg returns home unexpectedly and orders a stunned Passepartout to pack a single carpet-bag for an immediate journey around the world. Fogg places twenty thousand pounds in the bag, gives his whist winnings to a beggar, and they board a train at Charing Cross, just as Passepartout realizes he left his gas light burning.
